# Doriath

> Doriath is an open-source password and secrets vault app for the Nextcloud workspace.

Doriath is an open-source password and secrets vault app for the Nextcloud workspace. It stores per-user and per-team credentials with audited access and integrates with the Nextcloud authentication stack, replacing standalone password managers in the workspace. The app is in active development; consult the docs for the current release status. Released under EUPL-1.2 and maintained by Conduction since 2019.
